harness.name: FuzzingBrain
harness.description: LLM system built on OSS-Fuzz that finds vulnerabilities, builds PoC inputs and patches; a DARPA AIxCC entry.

uses.quote: FuzzingBrain is an LLM-powered autonomous system for vulnerability discovery and patching, built on the OSS-Fuzz toolchain.
A scan partitions the codebase into logic groups, reasons about vulnerability hypotheses (potential vulnerabilities), constructs candidate PoC inputs, and verifies every crash before it is reported.
